consent.title: Privacy & cookie choices
consent.bodyBefore: We store preferences and visit answers in your browser. Nothing is sold. Consent version {{version}}. See the
consent.essentialStorageHint: Visit answers and site content edits stay in localStorage.
consent.optionalAnalyticsHint: No third-party tracker is wired yet. Toggle saves your preference for launch.
consent.note: No Google tags, pixels, or affiliate scripts load until you enable them in a later release.
consent.dismissUnavailable: Dismiss is not available — choose a privacy option below

auth.signedOutLede: This area is for signed-in customers. Quiz answers, visit leads, and plan reviews still live in this browser's localStorage until a real backend exists — not production PHI storage.
auth.signInLede: Use your email and password, or Google / Apple when those providers are enabled in the Clerk Dashboard. Password recovery and email verification are handled by Clerk.
auth.signUpLede: Sign up with email (verification required when enabled in Clerk) or Google / Apple when those social providers are turned on in the Dashboard for this application.
